roles.name: Member 2 - Backend and deployment
roles.mission: Persist owner-scoped private drafts and publish only confirmed safe fields through a working HTTPS deployment.
roles.owns: app/api/*; lib/server/*; lib/contracts.ts; lib/supabase/browser.ts; database/*; root config
roles.reviewer: M3 checks the vision boundary; M4 checks privacy and persistence. Role slots are unassigned.

tasks.title: Prove setup and freeze the small contract
steps: Scaffold Next.js once, publish a hello-world HTTPS preview, and check Supabase database, private bucket and anonymous sign-in.
Own shared types and environment names; agree the three routes with M1/M3/M4 before parallel implementation.
tasks.done: The preview loads and service access is verified, or the team explicitly records a prototype-only contingency.
tasks.handoff: Share the preview, public configuration names and contracts; keep keys private.

tasks.title: Implement private storage and owner checks
steps: Create the reports schema and private report-photos bucket; deny direct table/storage access for both anon and authenticated client roles.
Verify the bearer token server-side for writes, check owner_id, and allow only JPEG/PNG/WebP <=3 MB decoded and normalized with metadata stripped.
tasks.done: One session can create its private report data; another session and unauthenticated requests cannot edit it or read private storage.
tasks.handoff: M1 gets the auth helper and upload errors; M4 gets the privacy-check procedure.

tasks.title: Deliver the persisted H3 manual slice
steps: POST one upload and location into a private needs_review draft; allocate one report ID and store the normalized image privately.
Return editable unclear/manual_fallback when analysis is unavailable; wire owner-only publish of that same row and a published-only public GET.
tasks.done: A manual draft can be reviewed, published and fetched after reload; failed storage never produces a publishable report.
tasks.handoff: M1/M4 run H3 against real persistence; fixture-only progress is explicitly marked.

tasks.title: Connect vision without blocking publication review
steps: Import M3's server-only adapter with a 12-second deadline; validate output and retain manual_fallback on failure.
Guard analysis updates against published rows; preserve server-set analysis_source/is_demo, require valid reviewed fields and keep the first published_at on repeat publish.
tasks.done: The H5 core runs with live vision or documented manual fallback; mocks stay samples and repeat publish updates the same report.
tasks.handoff: M4 records the selected H5 mode; M1 gets final response behavior.

tasks.title: Verify the release boundaries
steps: Run build/type checks and the privacy matrix: wrong owner, private draft, private photo, missing upload and secret exposure.
Run the deployed phone flow with M4; fix persistence, source-label or publication blockers before H7.
tasks.done: Required checks have recorded outcomes; the public response omits private fields and only reviewed published rows are visible.
tasks.handoff: Give M4 the final URL, commit, environment names and unresolved limits.

tasks.title: Freeze deployment and record recovery
steps: Freeze the reviewed deployment; write exact setup and recovery commands without credentials.
Rehearse provider failure and explicit sample mode; if storage/auth fails, keep publishing disabled and present a labeled backup/prototype.
tasks.done: M4 can explain and run the chosen contingency; no demo claims a successful save when persistence failed.
tasks.handoff: Send the operations note and evidence links to M4; leave future hardening open.

roles.name: Member 3 - Vision and smoke checks
roles.mission: Offer conservative visual suggestions with a bounded server call, honest provenance and a reliable manual fallback.
roles.reviewer: M2 checks server integration and secrets; M1 checks review wording. Role slots are unassigned.

tasks.title: Smoke-test model access and supply fixtures
steps: Check a currently available Gemini Flash-family vision model using @google/genai on the server; record the exact passing GEMINI_MODEL.
Give M1/M2 one conservative result fixture and one manual_fallback fixture even if live access is blocked.
tasks.done: Live access has a recorded outcome and teammates can build without it; no key or image content is logged.
tasks.handoff: M2 gets model/configuration names; M4 knows whether live AI is available.

tasks.title: Write the conservative adapter and schema
steps: Implement analyzeImage({bytes,mimeType}) returning allowed unique labels, evidence <=240 characters and boolean review_needed.
Prompt for visible clues only; reject unsupported labels, conflicting neutrals and invalid output, and apply M2's 12-second deadline.
tasks.done: One valid result parses; malformed output and provider failure raise a typed failure for manual review.
tasks.handoff: M2 imports the server-only adapter and validator; M1 gets plain-language labels.

tasks.title: Verify truthfulness at the H3 slice
steps: Run valid, unclear, malformed and unavailable-provider fixtures through M2's route.
Check failure uses unclear/manual_fallback; deliberate mock mode must mark is_demo=true from draft creation and remain a sample after review.
tasks.done: M1/M4 can distinguish live suggestions, manual review and simulated samples; no fallback is presented as successful AI.
tasks.handoff: Record H3 fixture outcomes and send any metadata/schema fix to M2.

tasks.title: Run six focused visual smoke cases
steps: Use six consented/licensed small images: visible litter, green surface, sheen-like surface, clean/glare, blur and mixed/ambiguous content.
Record provenance, expected visible cues, actual labels, source and failure; choose live or manual contingency with M2 at H5.
tasks.done: Six case outcomes or explicit access failures are recorded; selected examples are not described as model accuracy.
tasks.handoff: M4 gets honest examples and limitations; M1 gets any confusing wording.

tasks.title: Fix one material error and verify the fallback
steps: Make at most one focused prompt/schema correction for a demonstrated error; rerun affected smoke cases and preserve outcomes.
Check the final deployment's live request, provider failure and mock/sample labels; confirm every result still requires human review.
tasks.done: The final model/prompt version and tested behavior are recorded; no unsupported water-safety or toxin claim appears.
tasks.handoff: M2 freezes the prompt/model; M4 gets the verified AI explanation.

tasks.title: Prepare evidence and freeze vision
steps: Freeze the adapter and prompt; add smoke results, model ID and known limits to evaluation/README.md.
Give M4 one live example if available and a clearly labeled fallback example; rehearse without changing models late.
tasks.done: Rehearsal names the active mode and uses real recorded evidence; missing live access is disclosed plainly.
tasks.handoff: M4 receives demo images with provenance and a brief limitations statement.
